jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.
  
  

**What sets us apart drives us ahead:** between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.
  
  

Data Analyst
  
  

Stockholm \| 100% \| Reference 8249
  
  

As a Data Analyst, you will play a key role in ensuring the accuracy, quality and timeliness of financial market information across the Nordic markets. Working as part of a small, experienced team based in Stockholm, you will monitor, collect, validate and maintain a wide range of reference, corporate action and market data that supports business\-critical products and services used throughout the financial industry.
  
  

This is a varied and dynamic position that offers exposure to multiple Nordic exchanges, close collaboration with internal and external stakeholders, and the opportunity to further develop expertise in financial markets, market data and corporate actions within an international environment.
  
  

What You Will Do
  
  

* Monitor Nordic financial markets, company announcements and other information sources to identify and process corporate actions and market events within internal systems and databases.
* Handle and maintain a broad range of corporate action and market event data, including IPOs, rights issues, stock splits, redemptions, dividends, mergers and acquisitions, and other events affecting listed securities.
* Perform data quality controls, verification checks and discrepancy investigations to ensure information is accurate, complete, timely and reliable.
* Support customers and internal stakeholders with data\-related queries, working closely with index teams, exchanges and international colleagues to resolve inquiries and support business activities.
* Maintain operational databases, logs, calendars and documentation, while contributing to process improvements, system enhancements and user acceptance testing of new database releases.


What You Will Bring
  
  

* A strong interest in financial markets, market data and corporate actions, with a willingness to learn, develop professionally and take ownership of your responsibilities.
* Excellent attention to detail, strong organizational skills and a commitment to deliver accurate, high\-quality data while managing multiple tasks and changing priorities.
* Fluency in both Swedish and English, with strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders, colleagues and customers.
* Knowledge of the Nordic financial markets, advanced Microsoft Excel skills and relevant experience in Financial Data Operations, Market Data, Corporate Actions, Securities Administration, Back Office or a related field; and experience with AI tools, including Microsoft Copilot, are considered a plus.


If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills at \+44 207 550 5407\.
  
  

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.
  
  

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
* Application Deadline: Oct. 11, 2026
* Solna
**Job Description**
-------------------


**Coop Sverige – Together we make food\-Sweden sustainable**

At Coop, data plays an increasingly important role in how we understand our customers, improve our operations and make better decisions. With over 4 million members and data across stores, logistics and digital channels, we have both the scale and the opportunity to create real impact. To add to this, our data platform runs on an architecture suitable for providing agentic analytics!


Within our AI \& Business Intelligence organization, we have built a modern analytics platform that we are proud of – and we are now looking for a **Senior Data Analyst** to help us turn even more of that data into action.


***Om tjänsten:***
  

You will join our Analytics team within AI \& Business Intelligence, working closely with Data Engineers, Data Scientists and stakeholders across Coop.


As a Data Analyst, you sit at the intersection of technology and business. The role is not only about answering questions with data, but understanding the problem behind the question, challenging assumptions and determining what we should actually do with the insight.


You will have considerable freedom in how you approach problems. We believe in building reusable, scalable solutions in code rather than repeatedly solving the same problem manually.


**What you will do**

* Translate business challenges into analytical questions, solutions and recommendations aid all of Coop in decision making
* Work with large datasets across customer behaviour, sales, assortment, logistics and digital channels and develop scalable and reusable solutions with any too you see fitting the purpose.
* Build analytical agents, dashboards, ad hoc analyses or any other data product that democratizes our data.
* Challenge existing questions and ways of working – moving from “can you analyse this?” towards “this is what we should do.”

***Who are you?***


We believe you enjoy operating at the intersection of data, technology and business. You are curious enough to dig into the details, but can also step back and understand the bigger picture.


You don't see an analysis as finished when the numbers are correct – you want to understand what they mean and what action they should lead to. You are comfortable taking ownership even when the path forward is not completely defined.


**We believe that you**

* Have experience turning business needs into analytical questions and solutions.
* Are comfortable programming in SQL and Python, with experience of PySpark or similar technologies and have experience working with version control, such as Git.
* Have strong business understanding and can connect analytical findings to concrete actions and can communicate this effectively with any audience.
* Understand fundamental statistical methods and when different analytical approaches are appropriate.

**It’s meritorious if you**

* Have experience from a modern cloud\-based data platform or Lakehouse environment.
* Have worked with providing agentic analysis, analytics engineering, BI tools or code\-first analytical workflows.
* Have worked in a scale\-up, technology company, consultancy or another environment where broad ownership is expected.
* Have experience from retail, e\-commerce or another data\-intensive consumer business.

***About us***

The grocery trade is a stable, long\-term industry, and Coop’s offering is essential to the transition toward a greener, more sustainable future. You’ll join a culture defined by humility, initiative and strong values, where we take joint responsibility and genuinely want to help each other succeed. Our office in Solna Business Park offers a modern work environment with great transport links, a fantastic staff restaurant, and the option of hybrid work in agreement with your manager. At Coop, we work for our 4\.2 million members, making us by far the largest cooperation in Sweden.


If you have questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Hiring Manager Victor Kesten (victor.kesten@coop.se) or the recruiter Andreas Nilsson (andreas.nilsson2@coop.se)


*Welcome with your application!*

jobs.title: Accounting Business Analyst
jobs.description:
### **Your New Role**


We are looking for a highly experienced Accounting Business Analyst to join a major financial transformation initiative within a large, international financial services organization.


The initiative is focused on transforming the organization's accounting and reporting landscape by moving accounting functionality from several legacy solutions to a modern, cloud\-based platform. As an Accounting Business Analyst, you will play a key role in bridging accounting, business requirements and technology, helping translate complex financial processes into robust and implementable solutions.


You will work closely with business stakeholders, architects, developers, testers and other specialists across several agile teams. This role offers the opportunity to work hands\-on with accounting processes while contributing to a significant transformation in a highly regulated enterprise environment.

**In this role, you will:**

* Analyze functional and non\-functional requirements and translate them into accounting and configuration specifications.
* Translate business, accounting, reporting and reconciliation requirements into clear, implementable system requirements.
* Analyze financial processes and accounting scenarios across multiple front\-end and source systems.
* Define, document and maintain accounting patterns, process descriptions and solution designs.
* Support the configuration, operation and maintenance of a cloud\-based accounting solution and supporting financial systems.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, system architects, developers and test teams to clarify requirements and resolve functional questions.
* Produce and maintain high\- and low\-level design documentation as well as test scripts.
* Plan, prepare and execute testing of financial processes and accounting solutions.
* Support deployment, releases, troubleshooting, incident analysis and remediation across both non\-production and production environments.
* Contribute to common accounting standards, reconciliation principles and ways of working.
* Participate actively in agile ceremonies and cross\-team planning.
* Share accounting knowledge and provide guidance to other members of the project team.
* Train and coach end\-users to use the resulting accounting solutions confidently and effectively.

### **Company Presentation**


Our client is a Swedish bank operating in both the Nordic and Baltic regions, offering everything from digital solutions for everyday finance to comprehensive financial advice for private and corporate clients. Here, you’ll be part of an innovative journey where flexible, technology\-driven solutions deliver an exceptional customer experience. Headquartered in Stockholm, the organization values forward\-thinking, collaboration, and engagement in shaping the future of banking.

### **Good to Know**

**Scope of employment**: Full\-time, 100%  

**Type of contract**: Fixed\-term employment as a consultant via JobBusters.  

**Working model**: Hybrid  

**Start date**: 2026\-10\-01  

**End date**: 2027\-06\-30, with the possibility of extension  

**In your application**: Please ensure that your CV clearly demonstrates how you meet the qualifications required by the client.

### **To succeed in this role, you will need:**

* A master’s degree in information technology, Business Administration or a related field is preferred.
* Extensive experience in accounting, reconciliation and financial reporting.
* Strong ability to analyze complex accounting requirements and translate them into process descriptions, accounting patterns and system requirements.
* Solid understanding of accounting scenarios and the ability to confidently describe accounting flows, for example using T\-accounts.
* Experience planning, preparing and executing tests of financial processes and accounting solutions in a large or multinational enterprise.
* Experience from financial services, accounting, regulatory reporting or another highly regulated environment.
* Strong written and spoken English communication skills.
* Meritorious: Experience integrating large\-scale and customized business applications with Oracle Financials Cloud or a similar comprehensive accounting platform.
* Meritorious: Experience with change management, organizational transformation and end\-user training.

### **What we Offer**

* Secure employment with a collective bargaining agreement, insurance coverage and occupational pension
* Wellness allowance and employee discounts and offers via Benifex (e.g., health, leisure, transport and healthcare)
* Flex pension and access to the Lifeplan pension advisory service
* Additional compensation during parental leave
* Occupational health services
* Long\-term assignments and a dedicated Consultant Manager for personal support
* Opportunities to build valuable experience, expand your network and grow your future career

### **We look forward to receiving your application**


We review applications on an ongoing basis. As recruitment processes in the consulting industry can move quickly, the position may be filled before the advertised deadline — so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.


You do not need to submit a cover letter. Instead, please respond to the screening questions included in the application process.

jobs.title: Group Business Controller & BI Analyst
jobs.description:
**Group Business Controller \& BI Analyst**  

**Finance meets BI, automation and AI**



Do you enjoy working with numbers **and** technology? Are you curious about how data, automation and AI can make Finance smarter and more effective?
  

  

LEMAN is looking for a Group Business Controller \& BI Analyst who wants to combine hands\-on business controlling with BI development and help shape the future of Finance.
  

  

This is a hybrid role with an approximately 50/50 focus on business controlling and BI. You'll work with budgets, forecasts and performance analysis while also building Power BI solutions, improving reporting processes and exploring new ways to use automation and AI.
  

  

In other words: you don't just analyse the numbers. You help improve how we work with them.


**The role**
  

You'll join our Finance organisation and report to the Head of Controlling. You'll work closely with colleaguesreit in Finance, IT and across the business, giving you a broad network and plenty of opportunity to influence how we use data and technology.
  

  

As part of the role, you'll be responsible for controlling activities related to LEMAN Logistics, covering our warehousing operations in Denmark, Norway, the UK and the US. You'll work closely with local logistics directors and lead the monthly performance follow\-up.
  

  

You'll also support Group back\-office functions such as People \& Culture, IT and Commercial with financial analysis, reporting and decision support.


**Your main responsibilities**
  

* Prepare and follow up on budgets, forecasts and financial performance
* Analyse results, identify deviations and turn data into clear business insights
* Lead monthly performance reviews with local logistics directors
* Support Group functions with financial analysis and decision\-making
* Build and develop reports and dashboards in Power BI
* Take ownership of the continued development of BI solutions within Finance
* Identify opportunities to improve financial analysis, reporting and processes through automation and AI
* Act as the link between Finance, IT and the wider business
**Who are you?**
  

You have a solid foundation in controlling or finance analytics, but you're also genuinely interested in data, technology and how things can be done better.
  

  

You don't need to be an IT specialist. What matters is that you understand Finance, enjoy working with data and are comfortable getting hands\-on with technology.
  

  

We imagine that you:
  

  

* Have a relevant degree, such as cand.merc., HD or equivalent
* Have around 3–5 years of relevant experience in controlling, finance analytics or BI
* Have practical experience with Power BI and SQL
* Have an interest in automation, AI and new technology
* Understand budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis and management reporting
* Can turn business needs into practical reporting and BI solutions
* Communicate confidently with financial, technical and operational stakeholders
* Are curious, proactive and comfortable building relationships across the organisation
* Enjoy taking ownership and driving things forward
* Speak and write Danish fluently and have strong English skills

  

You don't have to tick every box. If you have a strong Finance background and a real interest in BI, technology and improving the way things work, we'd like to hear from you.
**A role with room to make a difference**
  

This isn't a role where you simply maintain existing reports and follow established processes.
  

  

You'll have the opportunity to shape how Finance works with data, BI, automation and AI and to see your ideas turn into solutions that are used across the organisation.
  

  

You'll be part of an experienced Finance team where you can exchange ideas, learn from colleagues and challenge existing ways of working. At the same time, your role will be highly visible across the organisation, giving you the opportunity to build a broad network and make a real impact.


**Why LEMAN?**
  

LEMAN is a global logistics company with an ambition to continuously improve how we use data and technology to make better business decisions.
  

  

We believe that good work should leave room for life outside work. That's why we offer:


• Flexible working from home by agreement  

* 11% employer\-paid pension contribution \+ 2% employee contribution
* Company\-paid internet and mobile phone
* Canteen and lunch scheme
* Insurance coverage
* Employee association with regular social activities
* Fitness facilities and massage treatment
* The opportunity to take 1–2 months of fully paid sabbatical leave
* **Enjoy a benefits package designed with you in mind:** 25 days of annual leave, five additional paid leave days, bank holidays, comprehensive medical coverage, pension and delicious meals. We can’t wait to tell you more in person!
* **Flexibility:** We understand that life is unpredictable, which is why we offer flexible working arrangements, where possible, to help you achieve a healthy work\-life balance. You'll have the freedom to structure your workday in a way that suits you best – whether that means working from home, adjusting your hours, or taking time off when you need it.
* **Sabbatical:** Need a break from the daily grind? We offer sabbatical opportunities to take extended time off to recharge, explore your passions, and come back to work feeling refreshed and inspired.
* **Investment in Professional Development:** We're committed to helping our people grow and reach their full potential.
* **Global Travel Opportunities:** We're a global organisation with offices around the world, which means that there are plenty of opportunities to travel and experience new cultures.
* **Social and Company Events:** We believe that work should be enjoyable, which is why we organise regular social and company events to bring our people together.
